text:
maria: Heads-up: we need a coordinated spec for the new customer pane metrics the product team requested. Main ask: noisy-neighbor signals + tenant isolation heatmap. Who can own runtime inputs and sample formats?

sanjay: I can own runtime side. We'll need to agree on which signals runtime emits vs what platform aggregates. My initial list: per-tenant queue_latency_ms (p50/p95), inference_qps, batch_size_dist, kv_cache_hit_ratio, gpu_util_by_shard. Also can emit model_variant label.

devon: @sanjay +platform team: we need a telemetry ingestion contract (small, typed). Proposed minimal fields: tenant_id, metric, value, timestamp, sample_rate, labels. Prefer pre-aggregated to avoid high-cardinality in metrics pipeline.

sanjay: ```json
{
  "tenant_id": "hash:sha256(...)",
  "metric": "inference_qps",
  "value": 12.3,
  "ts": 1680000000,
  "sample_rate": 1,
  "labels": {"model":"redwood-v1","shard":"gpu-3"}
}
```

liz: Product note: must ensure PII-free — tenant_id should be hashed, no user-level keys. Also need defined alert thresholds for noisy neighbor (eg q95 latency > 2x baseline for 5m). UX: heatmap shows relative deviation, not raw token traces.

owen: For console: we'll need an authenticated endpoint and RBAC. Plan: `/api/console/customers/:tenant_hash/metrics?view=isolation&from=...&to=...` Response must include a small set of precomputed aggregates to keep UI snappy. We can lazy-load drilldowns.

devon: Quick platform vs runtime debate: should we ask runtime to emit per-tenant aggregates, or ingest raw events and compute aggregates in pipeline? Ops leans runtime-side aggregation to reduce storage/ingest cost.

sanjay: Runtime can emit aggregates at 10s or 1m granularity, but we need the schema + back-pressure rules. High-cardinality labels (e.g., full request_id) will kill the metrics pipeline — must ban those.

oncall-bot: FYI: current metrics ingress rate cap for unaggregated events is ~1000/sec. Requesting more unaggregated will require infra ticket and quota bump.

maria: Action items: (1) @sanjay produce schema + sample payloads by EOD Tue; (2) @devon draft telemetry contract + ingest quotas; (3) @owen propose console wireframes + API surface; (4) @liz define alert thresholds & privacy guardrails. Sync Wed 10:00am. @here

devon: 👍 will draft contract today.

sanjay: 👍 will add example exporter and a tiny shim for emitting hashed tenant ids.

liz: also add a short paragraph on SLO impact for customers (how we surface noisy neighbor remediation steps).

owen: I'll mock up heatmap + isolation switch and share a Figma link in the thread before EOD.
